definitions.short: Charan , the name of a man and also of a place
definitions.full: H2771. Charan I. חָרָן proper name, of a location city in northern Mesopotamia (Assyrian —arrânu = road, path COT Gloss ; compare Dl Pa 185 ; Jen Kosmologie 28 'junction of trading-routes' = cross-roads ) — mentioned as city of Abram's sojourn Gen 11:31 , where his father Terah died 11:32 , and whence he departed for Canaan 12:4-5 , where Laban, Jacob's uncle, lived, and whither Jacob fled 27:43 ; 28:10 (both חָרָ֫נָה ), 29:4 ; as conquered by fathers of Sennacherib 2Kin 19:12 = Isa 37:12 ; as place of trade Ezek 27:23 ; Assyrian –arrana ( +? ), Schr COT on Gen 11:31 ; 27:43 ᵐ5 Χαρραν . It was an ancient seat of worship of moon-god (Sin), see Schr KG 355, 596 ; see further Chwolsohn Ssabier i, 303 ff. Wüstenfeld ZMG 1864, 443 f. Schr KG 355, 536 Sachau Reise 217 ff. Mez Geschichte. d. Stadt Harran, 1892 . II. חָרָן proper name, masculine son of Caleb of Judah 1Chr 2:46 (twice in verse); ᵐ5 Αρραν , ᵐ5 L Ωρων (Sabean proper name חרן DHM Epigr. Dakam. 56 ). חֹרֹן חוֺרֹן, see חוֺרֹן בֵּית above
